definitions.ask: Which glyph should replace the '#task #prj' identity pair?
definitions.why: The ^prj task states the project outcome, and ring-plus-dot stays legible at 0.8em

choices.label: A stroked target (ring plus center dot): the project outcome; simplest, crispest at 0.8em
A stroked signpost (Lucide milestone): reads as project milestone; busier at small sizes
A stroked folder: the classic project container; generic, and projects here are outcomes

definitions.ask: What ink should the '#hide' eye-off mark use?
definitions.why: Family grammar: identity-slot shapes in teal, trailing machine state in quiet grey

choices.label: The quiet grey metadata ink of the date marks: a dormant-state signal that stays out of the way
The family teal identity ink: consistent with identity glyphs but claims a kind for a state

definitions.ask: Where should the '#hide' eye-off mark render?
definitions.why: bob's review predicate hides any tagged task, so the truthful mark follows the engine

choices.label: Every task line with an exact whole-token tag; matches the engine, which hides any task
Only prj and ref identity rows; an ordinary hidden task would keep a misleading pill

definitions.ask: Should picker and Task Card display text also drop '#prj' and '#hide' like '#ref'?
definitions.why: Picker text spans two more plugins and suites; a follow-up bead keeps this tale bounded

choices.label: Rendering only in this tale; file picker-text parity as one follow-up task bead
Also strip the tags from picker text in bob-navigation-hotkeys and block-id-prompt now
